tafsirs.author: al-Tabatabaʾi
tafsirs.excerpt_en: "Best in deed" is not measured by abundance but by sincerity and conformity to what is right. Death is mentioned before life because the test demands awareness of finitude before living rightly within it.
tafsirs.excerpt_ar: «أحسن عملا» لا يقاس بالكثرة بل بالإخلاص والانطباق على الحق؛ وقُدّم ذكر الموت لأن الاختبار يستدعي الوعي بالفناء قبل العيش في حدوده.

tafsirs.author: al-Tabari
tafsirs.excerpt_en: The created order, its mortality and its quickening, is itself the apparatus of the trial. The verse closes on al-ʿAzīz al-Ghafūr to anchor accountability between power and pardon.
tafsirs.excerpt_ar: الخَلق بفنائه وحياته هو ذاته آلة الاختبار، وقد ختمت الآية بـ«العزيز الغفور» لتثبت المحاسبة بين القدرة والمغفرة.

hadiths.isnad_ar: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
hadiths.note: The opening hadith of Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb.

books.rationale: The earliest of the Four Books. Open at Kitāb al-ʿAql wa-l-Jahl, where the intellect is counted as the first of God's creations.
al-Ḥurr al-ʿĀmilī's concordance of the legal traditions of the Imāms. Open at the preliminaries of worship, where the chapters on intention anchor everything that follows.
Ibn Ḥajar's commentary on Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, the most consulted commentary in the Sunni canon. Open at the beginning of revelation, the Ṣaḥīḥ's own threshold.
al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī's al-Mīzān abridged: the Qurʾān explained through the Qurʾān. Open at al-Fātiḥa, where the method shows itself on the first seven verses.
al-Ṭūsī's examination of the legal traditions, one of the Four Books. Open at purity, the classical gateway of every fiqh collection.
The prayers of Imām Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn. Open at the first supplication, praise before every request.
al-Muhallab's abridgement of Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī. Open where the matn begins, with the hadith of intentions.
